summary: This study looks at how a very low-calorie ketogenic diet affects people with conditions like type 2 diabetes, obesity, and fatty liver disease. Researchers are comparing this special diet to a low-calorie Mediterranean diet. The trial includes 40 participants and is sponsored by Azienda Ospedaliero Universitaria Maggiore della Carita. Currently, the study status is Active, not recruiting.
